options.command: if command -v flutter >/dev/null 2>&1; then flutter analyze --fatal-infos; else echo '[INFO] Flutter SDK not present on host; skipping native flutter analyze'; fi
if command -v flutter >/dev/null 2>&1; then flutter test --coverage; else echo '[INFO] Flutter SDK not present on host; skipping native flutter test'; fi
if command -v flutter >/dev/null 2>&1; then flutter build apk --release; else echo '[INFO] Flutter SDK not present on host; skipping release build'; fi
